list: Official PS5 list: 55 trophies — 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, via Exophase and PSNProfiles, which agree on every entry.
note: Guides are written for this entry in our own words. Where a method is not yet confirmed in the game, the trophy is flagged unconfirmed and the guide says so plainly. The game released 19 November 2026, so early guidance is still being confirmed by the guides we cite.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is no extra task: the platinum is the reward for finishing everything else. Save A Long Road (100% completion) for last, since it is the longest grind, and the platinum will land the moment the final requirement ticks over.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally as you play through the start of the game. It cannot be missed.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies pop when the chapter's final mission wraps up, so just follow the story. It cannot be missed.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Like every chapter trophy, it pops when the chapter closes and cannot be missed.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. The trophy pops when the chapter's last mission finishes. It cannot be missed.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. The trophy pops when the chapter closes, setting up the finale. It cannot be missed.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. After it, the game keeps going in free roam, so nothing in the open world is cut off by finishing the story — cleanup for every other trophy stays open. It cannot be missed.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends, so play the mission through and it is yours. It cannot be missed.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are long, so expect several stages before the trophy pops at the end. It cannot be missed.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends. It cannot be missed.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends. It cannot be missed.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. It pops when the mission ends. It cannot be missed.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission ends. It cannot be missed.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) opens after the story, and progress you made earlier already counts toward it. Early guides report the checklist is lenient — PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion — but it is still the longest trophy, so treat it as the final stage of the roadmap and work through its checklist item by item. Nothing on it is missable.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Vice City Hustle — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count. Early lists count 397 stunts across Leonida, and 100% completion asks for 300, so keep going past 250 once this pops. Work region by region and use the in-game stunt markers so none are left behind.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity at least once. KeenGamer counts nine activity types, so sample everything you meet — races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, drone races, meditation, hunting and more — instead of grinding one thing. One try each is enough; you do not need to win or finish them all.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. Each challenge has its own gold score, so replay a challenge until you clear its gold bar — accuracy matters more than speed. Work through the ranges one at a time and use the counter in this guide to track how many golds you have.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations in total, per KeenGamer. Learn each course's gates before racing for the win, and fly clean rather than fast: one crash costs more than a cautious line. Tick locations off one by one.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each race only counts the first time you win it, so vary the events — different tracks, vehicles and race types — instead of replaying one favourite. Races can be done after the story.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish with Cal when his challenge comes up and out-fish him on the day. The exact challenge rules are still being confirmed by early guides, so treat this as unconfirmed: the description only promises a fishing contest against Cal, and the win is what pops the trophy.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, start a game and play it through to its end. Pick the shortest game on offer if you only want the trophy — finishing is what counts, not a high score.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's stranger strand through all of its missions until the last one ends. Stranger strands can be finished after the story, so there is no rush — but do not leave them all to the very end.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's stranger strand to its last mission. Like the other character finales, it can be done after the story.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's stranger strand to its last mission. It can be done after the story.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Only some stranger questlines count toward the eight, and early guides are still confirming exactly which ones qualify — Sixshore notes PowerPyx is still confirming the list. Finish every stranger strand you find, including the character finales, and keep count in this guide until eight are done.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's stranger strand to its last mission. It can be done after the story.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's stranger strand to its last mission. It can be done after the story.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, using both Jason and Lucia, per Vice City Hustle. This is the one trophy PowerPyx flags as possibly missable, and the only one on the list with any missable warning: do the meditation spots as you reach each area, starting in Chapter 1, and do not leave a region's spots for later. If a spot stops being available, it may be lost for this playthrough, and there is no New Game+. See the Missables page for the full warning.

sources.label: Vice City Hustle — GTA 6 Trophy List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (missable warning, as reported by GTABase and Vice City Hustle)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand until the hunt is offered, then track the specific animal it names and take it down. The exact animal and spot are still being confirmed by early guides, so this is flagged unconfirmed — the description only promises a unique hunt for Bret.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of 18 in total, per Sixshore. Cards are hidden across Leonida, so collect full sets rather than random singles — three finished sets pop the trophy. You do not need all 18 sets, and cards can be collected after the story.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK phone app at landmarks and scan them — each new location counts once. Work through the map region by region so you do not rescan the same spots, and use the counter in this guide to track progress toward 100.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, per GTA Spotter, and 100% completion asks for 70 — so keep going after this pops. Pick the easiest groups first and tick challenges off steadily alongside everything else.

sources.label: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build up to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by early guides, so this is flagged unconfirmed — the description is the whole method so far.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in one run with your partner beside you, and keep the wanted level alive between them — if it drops, the chain breaks and you start over. The exact chaining rule is still being confirmed, so this is flagged unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts the first time you find its type, so drive everything you see — cars, bikes, boats and aircraft — instead of sticking to one favourite. Combine this with exploring Leonida and the Scooter Bros registrations to make every trip count twice.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Gather a group of enemies first, trigger Combat Focus, and chain five takedowns before it runs out. A busy shootout is the easiest place to set it up — do not waste it on one or two stragglers.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. The description points at leaving by air without a booking — take a plane and get off the ground. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by early guides, so this is flagged unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description points at the Rhino tank — get into one and stir up trouble. What exactly counts is still being confirmed by early guides, so this is flagged unconfirmed rather than guessed at.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, take the goods and leave unseen — any alarm ends the attempt. The exact stealth rules are still being confirmed, so this is flagged unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Eight vaults exist in the game, per Vice City Hustle, and they open after an optional Chapter 4 mission — each robbery brings a 4-star wanted level, so plan the getaway before you crack the vault, not after. You only need five of the eight.

sources.label: Vice City Hustle — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, break it open, grab the cash and lose the cops. Trucks roam the map, so this can be done whenever one crosses your path.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Cover every region of the map — Vice City, the coast, the swamps and the countryside — until the whole state is revealed. Pair it with the stunt, WAiNK and vehicle hunts so every trip fills in more than one checklist at once.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Find one illegal operation per gang across Leonida and hit them all. The full gang list is still being confirmed by early guides, so this is flagged unconfirmed — work through the operations you find and keep count.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar along Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. The exact bar and trigger are not yet confirmed by early guides, so this is flagged unconfirmed rather than guessed at.

sources.label: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's front and out the other side — the description evokes the series' classic showroom smash. Which showroom counts is not yet confirmed, so this is flagged unconfirmed.

sources.label: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl a game at that alley and follow through on the shot. The exact requirement is not yet confirmed by early guides, so this is flagged unconfirmed.

sources.label: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is cryptic and early guides have not pinned the trigger yet — it likely involves a partner activity. This is flagged unconfirmed: keep playing with your partner and check back as guides confirm the exact method.

sources.label: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). This points at a story choice — it pops when a key decision is made. Which choice counts is not yet confirmed, so this is flagged unconfirmed; just keep playing the story and it should come.

sources.label: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something after a first failure. The exact event is not yet confirmed, so this is flagged unconfirmed — if something goes wrong, try it again.

sources.label: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method, per KeenGamer. It likely follows a strange encounter somewhere in Leonida — keep an eye on odd events as you explore, and check back as guides confirm what triggers it.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Strike someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — the bowling-pun name is the hint. The precise method is still being confirmed by early guides, per KeenGamer, so this is flagged unconfirmed.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; bank them through your contacts over time. The total is cumulative, so keep laundering after every score and it will add up.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spending is cumulative across every shop — clothes, gear, food and more all count — so it builds naturally as you play. Late in the game, top it up with big purchases if you are close.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — eight in total, per KeenGamer. Buy every garage you find for sale; they give you somewhere to keep the 100 vehicles from Whip It Good, so buy them as you earn the money.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Save vehicles you find into the app until ten are registered — it pairs with Whip It Good, so register the interesting ones as you discover them.
